summary: After a storm the mayor speaks first to the people hurt, then gives the practical orders in plain words, and thanks the crews, neighbors and helpers last.
realLife: Mayors after a tornado or flood began by naming the hurt and the loss, then said what the city was doing: declaring an emergency, closing roads, restoring power. They asked residents to cooperate and look after neighbors, spoke of rebuilding without hurry, and credited agencies and volunteers. One gave comfort as a funeral director would; one warned that repair would outlast a single term of office.
